delta_lever: Whether a scheduled crew pairing is inside its legal ceilings turns on a cell of the maximum-flight-duty-period matrix indexed by acclimated report time and segment count - ten irregular clock bands by seven columns of arbitrary half-hour values with no generating relation, replaced by a second matrix with different bands once the crew is augmented - and the answer wanted is the tightest of seven simultaneous limits; the default substitutes a single flat duty-day figure and stops at the headline limit.
gap_type: (b) a published constant set the default cannot reconstruct, applied through (e) an enumeration the default truncates
template: A - a real, published, citable, non-recallable constant set carried in the skill, with the working data (the roster) shipped and carrying no labels, plus multi-stage computation
gate_order_note: Run in the order S-LAYER-GATE-2026-07-28 section 9 sets: artifact determinacy FIRST, then recall, then licence. All three are recorded below in that order.

gate_1_artifact_determinacy.question: Once the task hands over everything it needs, is the withheld object still hidden?
gate_1_artifact_determinacy.argument: The withheld object is a 10x7 matrix of arbitrary half-hour values over irregular clock bands with NO generating relation - the values were set band by band by rulemaking, not computed - so no algebraic identity links a schedule to a cell. The roster is shipped WITHOUT legality labels and without any margin, ceiling or verdict column, which is the whole reason this candidate survived: a single labelled pairing yields a one-sided inequality on the cell its report time and segment count select, and a handful of labelled pairings bracket a cell to within the granularity of the schedules. Nothing in the shipped roster is a function of the matrix.
gate_1_artifact_determinacy.enforced_by: verifier/test_outputs.py::test_roster_carries_no_compliance_label rejects any column whose name matches legal/complian/violat/margin/maximum/limit/exceed and re-checks on every graded run that no golden is readable as a literal from the roster.

gate_3_recall_probe.method: claude-opus-4-8 via the local bridge, no tools, no network, no skill, n=4, asked in the shape the task takes: give the maximum flight duty period for a stated report time and segment count.
gate_3_recall_probe.route_a_recall: NO. Asked for three cells - report 0530 with 5 segments, 1300 with 3, 0430 with 7, true values 11:30 / 12:00 / 9:00 - the four samples returned 11:00/9:00/9:00, 12:00/12:00/10:00, 10:30/10:00/9:00 and 13:00/9:00/9:00. 0 of 4 on the first cell, four mutually contradictory tables, a spread of 10:30 to 13:00 on one cell. Mutual disagreement across samples is the strongest available evidence of fabrication rather than recall, and it is the 999a91d3 failure mode seen from outside.
gate_3_recall_probe.route_a_structural_finding: Three of the four samples invented a merged '1-2 segments' column that does not exist. The published columns are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7+; columns one and two happen to be equal throughout, which is what the model is reconstructing from, and merging them then shifts every later column.
gate_3_recall_probe.route_b_reconstruction: NO. There is no relation to reconstruct: the cells are rulemaking outputs, not a formula, and the shipped roster carries no labels from which a cell could be solved (see gate 1).
gate_3_recall_probe.route_c_library: NO. No package in the base image implements part 117, and the image carries no copy of the CFR. Base image is python:3.11-slim plus pinned pytest; the environment installs nothing else.
gate_3_recall_probe.route_d_script: NO. The prompt states the goal - report the margin, the governing limit and its margin - and never the matrix, the bands or the adjustments.
gate_3_recall_probe.verdict: NOT-RECALLABLE on the matrix. Bucket N evidence: sufficient to have killed the candidate, never sufficient to certify it. Only Gate 2 decides.
gate_3_recall_probe.what_the_model_DOES_hold: It correctly names the governing part and table unprompted, and the round-number limits (100 hours, 60, 190, 10, 30) are ordinary recall. Those are enumeration furniture, not the lever, and the task is built so they cannot carry a run on their own: the matrix decides every fdp_margin_min case and, through the argmin, both other fields.

engine_disclosure.flag: READ THIS BEFORE ACCEPTING THE TASK. The withheld object is a published lookup table, which is the over-represented engine in this set.
engine_disclosure.the_honest_position: Five of the shipped deliverables withhold a published constant set and multiply by it. This one withholds a published table too. That similarity is real and is not argued away below; what follows is the case that the ENGINE differs, and the call is left to a human rather than allowed to surface at QC.
argument_for_a_different_engine: The shipped table tasks are EMISSION: look the constant up, multiply, report the product. The graded quantity is a monotone image of the constant, so the whole task is one lookup wearing a coat.

Here the graded quantity is a LEGALITY DETERMINATION: an argmin over seven simultaneous constraints and its value. The table supplies one of the seven. Two of the three graded fields are decided by which constraint wins, not by the table's value directly, and on seven of seventeen pairings the winner is not the table at all.

The table therefore cannot be consumed by substitution. A run must know the matrix AND enumerate the rest AND add the pairing's own contribution to three rolling totals AND resolve a six-part conditional on the split-duty relief AND decline a real, correctly-recalled relief provision that does not apply to a schedule. Two measured controls isolate that: flight_duty_period_only and cumulative_limits_ignored both use the CORRECT matrix and still miss 24 and 6 graded cases respectively.

The index is two-dimensional over irregular bands, and there is a second table with different bands. The dominant observed failure in the recall probe is not a wrong value but a wrong SHAPE - three of four samples invented a column that does not exist - which is a failure of the indexing discipline rather than of memory for a number.
argument_against: The lever is still a table, and a reviewer who is counting engines by what is withheld rather than by what is done with it will count this as the sixth.

The matrix is a public document and is fetchable with network access. Unlike the anonymised-instrument tasks in this set, the lever cannot be made un-fetchable; only the graded FIGURES are un-fetchable, because the roster is synthetic. See anonymisation below.
The enumeration half of the engine is measurable but smaller than the table half: 17 of 51 graded cases are decided by the matrix alone.
engine_disclosure.call: LEFT TO A HUMAN. This report does not claim the engine is new. It states the similarity, states the difference, and gives the two measurements a reviewer needs to decide - flight_duty_period_only at 37/51 and cumulative_limits_ignored at 45/51, both with the correct matrix.

sources.role: the withheld limit set - tables A, B and C and every non-tabular limit
sources.title: 14 CFR part 117, Flight and duty limitations and rest requirements: flightcrew members
sources.publisher: US Government Publishing Office (GovInfo), Code of Federal Regulations annual edition

golden_verification.method: INDEPENDENT SECOND FORMULATION, inside the verifier, running on every graded run. The oracle carries a hand transcription of the three tables and the fifteen section limits and answers by an ordered linear scan over clock ranges, subtracting the scheduled duty from the cell. verifier/reg_reparse.py shares none of that: it parses the tables out of the published <GPOTABLE> elements of verifier/part117.xml, re-reads every non-tabular limit out of the published section prose with its own regular expressions, selects a row through a 1440-entry minute-indexed array rather than a scan, and forms every duty-time margin as a release deadline in absolute clock minutes rather than as a maximum minus a duration.
golden_verification.agreement: EXACT. 23,040 table-cell queries, 15 section limits and 119 pairing margins; worst disagreement 0 minutes.
golden_verification.standing_tripwire: verifier/test_outputs.py::test_published_tables_are_intact asserts the shape (10 rows x 7 segment columns for the unaugmented matrix, 3 and 5 rows for the other two), the published clock bands in the published order, a tiling of the day with no gap or overlap, cells that are positive half hours, monotone non-increase across the segment axis, dominance of the augmented matrix over the unaugmented one at every minute, and section limits equal to the values quoted from the published text. A mistranscribed cell cannot pass silently.
golden_verification.cannot_skip: An absent or unreadable verifier/part117.xml raises at import, so every test in the module fails and verifier/test.sh gates the run to zero. There is no SKIP path.
golden_verification.supplement: build/independent_check.py reproduces the same claim from a fresh clone in one command; it resolves every path relative to the bundle root and reads nothing outside the bundle.
golden_verification.plausibility_envelope: Declared bound: -720 <= graded margin <= 720 minutes, and no margin exactly zero. It follows from the regulation - the largest published duty ceiling is 19:00 and the smallest 9:00 - so a margin larger than half a day means a unit slip or a dropped day-wrap. The goldens run from -43 to +38 minutes. Asserted by test_plausibility_envelope on every graded run and again in build/independent_check.py.

anonymisation.method: The roster is entirely synthetic. No carrier, airport, aircraft type, flight number or crew member appears; pairings carry opaque labels; every schedule and every duty-history figure was solved backwards from a target margin rather than taken from an operator.
anonymisation.why: The limit tables are a public document and the part must be identifiable for the task to be coherent, so unlike the anonymised-instrument tasks in this set the LEVER cannot be made un-fetchable. Making the roster synthetic makes the GRADED FIGURES un-fetchable instead: not one of the 51 reference values is a published statistic of anything.
anonymisation.residual_risk: An agent with network access could still retrieve the tables themselves. Mitigated by running the pilot with the egress firewall enabled (ERZA_EGRESS_FIREWALL=1 plus the _hook on PYTHONPATH) and requiring <rollout>/egress/probe.txt to read inet=BLOCKED as per-run evidence, because benchflow drops network_mode: no-network for LLM arms. This is weaker than anonymisation of the lever and is labelled as such.

graded_set.composition: three figures per pairing: the margin against the duty-period ceiling, the name of the governing limit, and that limit's margin
graded_set.prime_count: 17 pairings, prime. The convention exists so that no golden lands on a round value through a denominator, and it does less work here than for a ratio, because these goldens are differences of clock minutes. What carries the guess resistance is measured instead and re-measured on every graded run by test_guess_resistance_and_decoy_freedom: no graded margin sits within tolerance of zero or of any multiple of 30 minutes from -180 to +180, none coincides with a published table cell, and none coincides with the elapsed duty period, the scheduled flight time or the rest before duty of its own pairing.
graded_set.no_free_cases: Every pairing is graded on all three figures; there is no unlabelled or trivially-derivable case in the set. Six pairings comply and eleven do not, so neither compliance verdict is the majority answer, and all seven limit names occur across the roster.
design_invariants_asserted_at_build: unaugmented pairings are governed by the duty-period ceiling, with a runner-up limit close enough above it that an inflated ceiling moves which limit governs
augmented pairings are governed by some OTHER limit, with the duty-period margin close enough above it that a deflated ceiling moves it
no two limits tie inside a pairing, so the tie-break rule is never load-bearing
no margin is exactly zero, so no compliance verdict sits on a knife edge
graded_set.why_that_design: Those two invariants are what make the nearest real competitor reproduce NOTHING. A flat ceiling over-estimates for every unaugmented pairing (the largest unaugmented cell is 14:00 and none of the ten sits there) and under-estimates for every augmented one (all seven augmented cells exceed 14:00), so it moves the argmin in both directions and misses all 51 cases.

measured_separation.units: multiples of the graded tolerance, which is 1 minute

nearest_real_competitor.name: flat_14h_duty_day
nearest_real_competitor.what_it_is: a flat fourteen-hour duty ceiling in place of the matrix, with every other limit enumerated and applied correctly - the route a scheduler who knows the limits exist but not the matrix actually takes. 14 hours is the figure the regulation itself states for the combined split-duty period and the figure the superseded domestic scheduled-duty rule used, so it is the number that is reached for.
nearest_real_competitor.worst_gap: 330x on the duty-period margin, 280x on the governing margin
nearest_real_competitor.verified_live: verifier/test_outputs.py::test_nearest_competitor_reproduces_no_graded_case recomputes this on every graded run rather than reading the ledger, and verification/rederivation_test.py::test_ledger_separation_recomputes does it again from the bundle.

non_discriminating_routes_recorded_expli.segment_column_ignored: Reproduces 9 of the 30 cases it is scored over. Reading the matrix on the report-time axis alone is NOT an error on the bands where the published columns coincide: columns one and two are equal in every row, and columns three and four repeat them in several rows. That is a property of the published table, disclosed rather than engineered away - removing every such band from the roster would have meant excluding real report times to flatter a control.
non_discriminating_routes_recorded_expli.cumulative_limits_ignored: Reproduces 45 of 51 and is measured at ZERO on every duty-period margin, because it changes nothing about the matrix. It is kept because it is the only path that isolates the enumeration channel, and its separation on the governing margin (10x at its smallest) is what that channel is worth.
non_discriminating_routes_recorded_expli.flight_duty_period_only: Reproduces 37 of 51 and is measured at ZERO on every duty-period margin, for the same reason. Labelled floor-bounding rather than a competing method: it is not producible by a run that does not already hold the matrix.
non_discriminating_routes_recorded_expli.unforeseen_extension_applied: Reproduces 14 of 51. It moves every duty-period margin by exactly 120 minutes, so it fails all 17 of those cases, but on the seven pairings where a non-duty limit governs the argmin is unchanged and both other figures survive.

constant_answer_floors.measured: always_flight_duty_period = 10 of 17 names, i.e. 10 of 51 graded cases (19.6 per cent). Every other constant name scores 1 or 2. No constant margin scores anything: the guess family {0, +/-30, +/-60, +/-90, +/-120, +/-150, +/-180, 600, 840} reproduces zero graded margins.
constant_answer_floors.honest_reading: This is the floor of the instance and it is a DIRECT CONSEQUENCE of the design that makes the nearest competitor reproduce nothing. A flat ceiling can only over-estimate against the unaugmented matrix, so the only way to make it move the argmin on an unaugmented pairing is for the duty period to be the governing limit there. That forces the governing name to be flight_duty_period on all ten unaugmented pairings.
constant_answer_floors.the_trade: Balancing the name distribution would have handed the nearest competitor the governing name and margin on every unaugmented pairing where a non-duty limit governs - roughly 12 free cases - and broken the 'reproduces nothing' property the brief asks for. Concentrating the names costs a measured 10-case floor on ONE of three fields, and that floor cannot be collected together with any margin case. Recorded rather than hidden; a reviewer who prefers the other trade should say so.
constant_answer_floors.what_it_bounds: A no-skill run that answers flight_duty_period everywhere and guesses the margins scores 10/51 = 0.196. It cannot do better without the matrix.
